calculation.description: Fade each instrument's five-session return relative to the daily cross-sectional median, scaling by its trailing 20-session return volatility. Inputs are lagged through the prior completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Validated across 15 tradable synthetic cross-asset instruments and multiple regimes; dates require at least 8 valid names. Daily gate passes, while longer-horizon decay is weak, so use as short-horizon signal pending deterministic correlation audit.
